ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for sharing your feedback. It's normal for food to cook at different rates across the cooking grates, as heat can vary depending on the burner location, airflow, and where the food is positioned. For the most even results, we recommend monitoring the food as it cooks and moving pieces to different areas of the cooking grates as needed. This helps account for natural variations in heat and ensures each piece reaches the desired level of doneness. We hope this helps explain why rotating or repositioning food may be necessary during cooking.

Results.ReviewText:
I have been using the spirit for many cooks and have used the sear zone successfully. My large Weber bit the biscuit after many years and dropping down in size was a concern. 
I was pleasantly surprised and how efficient it was and how quickly it heated up. 
A few draw backs 
1) the knobs have a plastic interior and it only took a few months before the broke and need replacing 
2) I really miss the outside hanger for the propane, I like to see the weight scale to see if I was running low 
3) the propane tank is under the Bbq so a bit of a pain to get to especially after a cook as it’s easy to burn your forearms when turning off the gas while it’s still cooling
Results.Title: Overall I was surprised
